author: Ezo
text_post: Basically what you want to read up on is framewars. Something that I have found works like a charm is that when you meet a new alpha male, you dont feel intimidated or try to prove yourself to him, which is also a form of fear. You dont even try to patronize him or show that you are higher than him which is acknowledgning your need to show off. Instead, you greet him as an equal, showing him that you respect him. You are happy to meet someone of your own caliber for once. This is a trait of a real alpha male. It shows that you have no doubt that you are at his level and dont need to compete. The only ones who can be so relaxed in the company of another alpha male is the one who without a doubt is more alpha.
